source_policy.tingkatan1: KP2027 separated; no verified official SP textbook import yet; DO NOT use KSSM T1 as 2027

non_destructive.duplicate_import_warning: ONLY four files listed in packs should be considered for eventual controlled import. Older 5, 60, 120 and 180 packs are archives, not additional records.
